source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why does a description that says only "helps with documents" give weak selection guidance?

options.text: It omits the entire step-by-step procedure
options.feedback: A description is supposed to be shorter than the full instructions. The problem is unclear scope, not the absence of every step.

options.text: It fails to include a finished document from each run
options.feedback: Selection guidance should describe recurring work. Appending finished outputs does not repair an unclear task boundary.

options.text: It lacks the names of every file in the assets folder
options.feedback: An inventory of assets does not itself explain the skill's purpose. The description needs a clear outcome and use condition.

options.text: It leaves the intended task too vague
options.feedback: A useful description indicates both the outcome and when the skill applies, so a broad label makes relevance harder to judge.
